hub_retired.why_draft_and_not_trash: CRITICAL: trashing the parent renames its slug to 'products__trashed', which would rewrite every child URL to /products__trashed/hipaa/ etc. That is the exact defect found earlier on the trashed project-category parent (86292). Draft preserves post_name, so all six child URLs are unchanged.
